description: One case per toggle: the estate with assistantOutputCheckOff on and nothing else. The known answer is F-ASSISTANT-OUTPUT-CHECK, the Finding of Check ASSISTANT-OUTPUT-CHECK, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: assistantOutputCheckOff, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 assistantOutputCheckOff=true
setup.note: the as-found script does not offer this toggle yet; until it does, the known answer is checked only against the local snapshot

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.
